experiment_name: SafeTour AI Shortest vs. Safest Route Comparison Benchmark

risk_calculation_methodology.safety_score_source: Edge-Conditioned Multi-Head GATv2 model predictions (0 to 100 scale)
risk_calculation_methodology.shortest_path_cost: cost_short(e) = length(e) in meters (minimizes physical distance)
risk_calculation_methodology.safest_path_cost: cost_safe(e) = risk(e) (minimizes cumulative segment risk along the route)
risk_calculation_methodology.cumulative_risk_formula: Cumulative Risk = sum_{e in path} risk(e)
